ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with high-intensity (white) localized speckling and linear clusters across the ventral fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curvature extending from the medial section to the distal fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast circular white pixels (barnacles) at both distal tips; secondary smaller white circular spots distributed across the central fluke area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct, approximately parallel, diagonal high-contrast linear marks localized on the medial-lateral quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct rake marks (linear scratches) on the right lobe and extensive barnacle colonization at the fluke tips.
